'''Shock-filaments''' were capable of transmitting a [[stun charge]] when an individual came into close proximity to them.<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref> [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]] incorporated shock-filaments into the weapon's [[power tip]] that were capable of [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] a target if they moved to within four [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] of the tip.<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Xufal D'uat]] lined the bulkheads and flooring of his [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]], [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Venom Sting'']] with shock-filaments. The stun charges could be triggered from a hidden panel in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].<ref name="SS" />
